Title: Azure SQL Managed Instance —Public preview updates for late-May 2023

Body.Content:
In late May 2023, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL Managed Instance:

Ledger in Azure SQL Managed Instance allows you to enable cryptographic proof that a database has not been tampered with and establishes trust across different business entities.
